PHASE.NAME: RTK Language Adapter Parity
PHASE.GOAL: Port or wrap RTK language ecosystem adapters for Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go, Ruby, Rust, JVM, and .NET workflows.

STEPS.step-1: Add command-specific adapter behavior for pytest, ruff, mypy, pip, npm, pnpm, next, playwright, prettier, prisma, tsc, vitest, go, golangci, rake, rspec, rubocop, cargo, gradlew, and dotnet reports where proxy filtering is insufficient.
STEPS.step-2: Expand router families and examples to reflect supported language adapter coverage.
STEPS.step-3: Add any missing inline filter cases discovered while porting command-specific adapters.
